title: 第9章 回村插秧
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
“哥，真不怪我。”

    “我也不知道什么红丸护啊。”

    李西朋知道了，什么勾八魔王护，上面还有红丸护。

    但事已至此，他也没办法。

    “我不管。”

    李西海道：“这周末，陪我回乡下一趟。”

    李西朋见鬼一样，“哥，你看看这季节。”

    “你知道这意味着什么吗？”

    李西海无奈道：“我怎么不知道，可没办法啊。”

    “不回去不行。”

    李西朋咬牙道：“我真的是……。”

    “行吧行吧，陪你回去。”

    “那就说定了啊。”

    李西海摆了摆手。

    ……

    晚上。

    “刚子有事，来不了。”

    关阳说道。

    罗志道：“刚子转正后，忙的不可开交，少有机会出来喝酒的。”

    “今晚就咱们三个。”

    李西海点了点头。

    两人出差回来，就约好周五晚上聚一聚。

    杨刚在县局上班，治安警察，越是周末的时候，越要维护秩序。

    “听刚子说，你不走了。”

    罗志碰了一个，问道：“准备在县里干点什么？”

    李西海笑道：“暂时就游手好闲着。”

    “阿姨叔叔不管你？”关阳疑惑道。

    他知道李西海家里的情况，说正式编制的工作，可能要走考试流程，有点麻烦。

    但走事业编制，是很轻松的。

    “好不容易回来，先休息休息再说。”

    李西海转移话题，道：“你呢，你这次出差干什么去了？”

    “去市里开个会。”

    罗志说道：“老关知道，我们正好在一起。”

    “县里发展落后，烂尾房出了不少。”

    “大老板跟着被市里的大佬叼了。”

    他很是摇头。

    罗志跟关阳都在县府上班。

    罗志是县府办的办事员，关阳是县委办的。

    “咱们先就那样，要地理优势没有，要资源也没多少。”

    “人口净流失。”

    李西海听老爸念叨过不少，都想振兴县城，可钱呢？资源呢？

    什么都没有。

    谁会来投资，谁看得起这穷乡僻壤啊。

    关阳跟罗志都笑了笑，事实就这样，无可辩驳。

    “不过，这次我们倒是认识了大老板的大秘。”

    “谁？”

    李西海惊讶道。

    大老板就是县委的班长。
content_en:
"Brother, you really don't blame me."

    "I don't know what Benimaru is."

    Li Xipeng knew that the Gou Ba Demon King Protector had the Red Pill Protector on it.

    But now that it was over, there was nothing he could do.

    "I don't care."

    Li Xihai said: "This weekend, come with me back to the countryside."

    Li Xipeng looked like he had seen a ghost, "Brother, look at this season."

    "Do you know what this means?"

    Li Xihai said helplessly: "Why don't I know? I can't help it."

    "I can't do it without going back."

    Li Xipeng gritted his teeth and said, "I really am..."

    "Okay, okay, I'll go back with you."

    "Then it's settled."

    Li Xihai waved his hand.

    ……

    night.

    "Gangzi has something to do and can't come."

    Guan Yang said.

    Luo Zhidao: "After Gangzi became a full-time employee, he was very busy and rarely had the chance to go out for a drink."

    "It's just the three of us tonight."

    Li Xihai nodded.

    When the two came back from a business trip, they made an appointment to get together on Friday night.

    Yang Gang works at the county bureau as a security policeman. On weekends, he has to maintain order more.

    "Listen to Gangzi, you are not leaving."

    Luo Zhi touched one and asked, "What are you going to do in the county?"

    Li Xihai smiled and said, "I'll just be idle for the time being."

    "Auntie and uncle don't care about you?" Guan Yang asked doubtfully.

    He knew the situation in Li Xihai's family and said that formal establishment work might require an examination process, which was a bit troublesome.

    But it is very easy to adopt the career establishment.

    "It's hard to come back. Let's rest first."

    Li Xihai changed the subject and said, "What about you, what did you do on this business trip?"

    "Go to the city for a meeting."

    Luo Zhi said: "Lao Guan knows that we happen to be together."

    "The county is lagging behind in development, and there are a lot of unfinished houses."

    "The big boss was caught by the big guys in the city."

    He shook his head very much.

    Luo Zhi and Guan Yang both work in the county government.

    Luo Zhi is a clerk in the county government office, and Guanyang is in the county government office.

    "Let's just do that for now. We don't have any geographical advantages and we don't have many resources."

    "Net population loss."

    Li Xihai had heard his father talk about it a lot, and he wanted to revitalize the county, but where was the money? What about resources?

    Nothing.

    Who will invest in this remote country?

    Guan Yang and Luo Zhi both smiled. This is the fact, irrefutable.

    "However, this time we got to know the big boss' secret."

    "Who?"

    Li Xihai said in surprise.

    The big boss is the squad leader of the county party committee.
